{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values and sentinel values
print("Missing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

print("\nSentinel values in customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

print("\nValue counts for converted:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check for any non-numeric revenue values
print("\nUnique revenue values:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10

# Check if revenue is string due to Excel export
print("\nIs revenue string?", sales_df['revenue'].dtype == 'object')"}
